scope: Explicit test-source execution using the locally extended compiled SafeJS public core and our own document model. Public sites are read-only HTTP loads; injected scripts use actual guest DOM addEventListener/removeEventListener bindings and modify only local trees. Host-dispatched events are not a native click/default-action pipeline. No website-authored scripts, browser engine or automatic page-script execution are enabled. No raw responses or credentials are retained.
